name: ChineseSnacks Editorial Team
bio: ChineseSnacks is an independent editorial team publishing practical guides to eating street food in China. Every guide is built from verifiable sources: price ranges checked against current market data and online retail channels, snack recommendations cross-referenced with local community feedback (including Reddit's r/beijing and r/chinesefood), brand and product details sourced from official channels, and locations verified against maps and traveler reports. Content is reviewed quarterly, and reported errors are corrected within days.
